name: pi-worker
description: nubl's headless pi execution component: one supervisor per Linux user, typed B2 API over a private Unix socket

scripts.api:lint: REDOCLY_TELEMETRY=off REDOCLY_SUPPRESS_UPDATE_NOTICE=true redocly lint --config api/redocly.yaml b2 && node tools/codegen/lint-fixtures.mjs
scripts.api:bundle: REDOCLY_TELEMETRY=off REDOCLY_SUPPRESS_UPDATE_NOTICE=true redocly bundle --config api/redocly.yaml b2
scripts.test:go: cd clients/go && go vet ./... && go test -race ./... && go test -tags integration ./... && ./stdlib-gate.sh
scripts.check: npm run api:lint && npm run check:generated && npm run build && npm test && npm run test:go
